name: skill-chain
description: An opinionated 0-to-8 skill chain for agentic software development: product vision, brainstorming, requirements, architecture, wave plans, execution, QA, documentation and PR delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Idea to merged PR, one numbered step at a time
interface.longDescription: A 0-to-8 chain that turns a rough product idea into a buildable concept, explores UI shape when needed, writes requirements, creates architecture and wave-based implementation plans, executes with TDD and hard wave gates, runs QA, curates documentation, and delivers a PR. Two human checkpoints frame the autonomous middle: plan approval before execution and PR review after delivery.
defaultPrompt: Where am I in the skill chain, and what should I do next?
I have an idea for a feature I'd like to build.
The plans are approved — start the implementation waves.
